title: 다쳤을 때: 저기요, 좀 도와주세요!
objective: Say where you are hurt, ask for help, and use -을게요/-ㄹ게요.
summary: Learn to ask a stranger for help when you get hurt.
setting: A running path in a park in Seoul. Alex fell while jogging, hurt an ankle, and asks a passerby for help.

task.title: Ask for and offer help
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to answer in Korean.

words.meaning: to get hurt, to injure (a body part)
words.exampleMeaning: I hurt my hand, so I can't write.

words.meaning: to get up, to stand up (from the ground)
words.exampleMeaning: My leg hurts, so I don't think I can get up.
The ambulance will be here soon.
My friend bought the medicine for me.

dialogue.meaning: Are you okay? Where are you hurt?

dialogue.korean: 넘어져서 발목을 다쳤어요. 혼자 일어날 수 없어요.
dialogue.meaning: I fell and hurt my ankle. I can't get up by myself.

dialogue.korean: 피도 나네요. 움직이지 마세요. 제가 119에 전화할게요.
dialogue.meaning: You're bleeding, too. Don't move. I'll call 119.
Thank you so much. It really hurts.

dialogue.korean: 구급차가 올 때까지 제가 옆에 있을게요.
dialogue.meaning: I'll stay with you until the ambulance comes.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -을게요/-ㄹ게요: ① 목이 말라요? 제가 물을 ____. (가져오다) ② 휴대폰을 잃어버렸어요? 제가 ____. (찾다) ③ 혼자 못 가요? 제가 병원까지 같이 ____. (가다)
Choose the right word (넘어졌어요 / 일어나세요 / 불러 주세요): ① 길이 미끄러워서 ____. ② 사람이 쓰러졌어요. 구급차를 빨리 ____! ③ 괜찮아요? 천천히 ____.
Answer in Korean: A stranger asks you "어디 다쳤어요?" You fell down and hurt your hand.
Put the words in order: 전화할게요 / 대신 / 제가 / 병원에
Answer in English: 대화에서 누가 119에 전화해요?
answers: ① 가져올게요 ② 찾을게요 ③ 갈게요
① 넘어졌어요 ② 불러 주세요 ③ 일어나세요
제가 대신 병원에 전화할게요. (대신 제가 병원에 전화할게요. / 제가 병원에 대신 전화할게요. / 병원에 제가 대신 전화할게요. / 병원에 대신 제가 전화할게요.)
